::: {#hero-heading}

I am an Assistant Professor of Plant Ecology and Head of the Laboratory of Quantitative Ecology at Charles University in Prague, Czech Republic. I am a quantitative ecologist studying long-term biodiversity dynamics across large spatial and temporal scales. My work integrates fossil-pollen archives, contemporary vegetation, functional traits, climate data, and quantitative modelling to understand ecological memory, biodiversity change, human impacts, and climate-change responses. I lead open and reproducible data-integration and software-development workflows in R.

**Research identifiers:** [ORCID 0000-0002-9796-5081](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9796-5081) | [Scopus ID 57209659764](https://www.scopus.com/authid/detail.uri?authorId=57209659764) | [ResearcherID AAC-7606-2019](https://www.webofscience.com/wos/author/record/AAC-7606-2019)

## Software development

I lead or contribute to open ecological data infrastructure and R software:

* [VegVault](/projects/BIODYNAMICS/index.qmd#vegvault) - an integrated global palaeo- and neo-vegetation database with functional traits and abiotic drivers
* [{vaultkeepr}](https://ondrejmottl.github.io/vaultkeepr/) - an R interface for reproducible access to VegVault
* [RRatepol](/projects/RRatepol/index.qmd) 
* [RFossilpol](/projects/FOSSILPOL/index.qmd)
* [REcopol](/projects/REcopol/index.qmd)
* [RUtilpol](/projects/RUtilpol/index.qmd)
* [taxospace](https://github.com/OndrejMottl/taxospace)
